# UK GDAD PCF

> A companion site to the UK Government Digital and Data (GDAD) Profession
> Capability Framework (PCF): every role, level and skill across UK
> government, restated as plain files and extended with a start-here
> learning pathway, upskilling resources, a development checklist, two
> voices each of psychometric assessment and competency assessment
> (assessor-administered and self-practice/self-rating) and a skills gap
> form, for every one of 205 role levels. This is not a
> government service. Role summaries are Crown copyright, adapted under the
> Open Government Licence v3.0; everything else is AI-assisted with human
> review. For anything that carries weight — pay, grading, recruitment,
> promotion — use the official framework at
> https://ddat-capability-framework.service.gov.uk/ and talk to your
> organisation.

## Find things

- [Professions](https://uk-gdad.github.io/professions/): The eight
  professions in the framework, each with its roles and levels.
- [Roles](https://uk-gdad.github.io/roles/): A searchable finder across
  every role level.
- [Skills](https://uk-gdad.github.io/skills/): Every skill the framework
  names, and every level that expects it.
- [Skills self-assessment](https://uk-gdad.github.io/skills-self-assessment/):
  A single-page tool for rating yourself against the whole skill catalogue.

## Per role level

Each of the 205 role levels has its own page under each of these paths —
substitute a slug such as `data/data-analyst/2-data-analyst` for `<slug>`:

- `https://uk-gdad.github.io/roles/<slug>/` — the role summary.
- `https://uk-gdad.github.io/start-here/<slug>/` — first orientation and a
  learning pathway.
- `https://uk-gdad.github.io/upskilling/<slug>/` — courses, articles, videos,
  books.
- `https://uk-gdad.github.io/continuing-professional-development/<slug>/` —
  a CPD checklist.
- `https://uk-gdad.github.io/assessments-by-assessor/<slug>/` — a
  structured assessment an assessor administers.
- `https://uk-gdad.github.io/assessments-by-yourself/<slug>/` — the same
  four assessment types as practice material.
- `https://uk-gdad.github.io/competency-assessments-by-assessor/<slug>/` —
  a skill-by-skill matrix an assessor rates a candidate or employee against.
- `https://uk-gdad.github.io/competency-assessments-by-yourself/<slug>/` —
  the same matrix, generated from its sibling, for you to rate yourself
  against.
- `https://uk-gdad.github.io/skills-gap-forms/<slug>/` — a form to compare
  what you do now against what the level expects.

## Optional

- [About](https://uk-gdad.github.io/about/): Provenance, licensing, and how
  the site is built.
- [Sitemap](https://uk-gdad.github.io/sitemap.xml): Every URL the site

- [Source repository](https://github.com/uk-gdad/uk-gdad): Where all of this
  is written and reviewed before publishing.
